title: Counterparty dataset release
description: Whether a requested dataset may be released to a counterparty under an executed agreement. Synthetic; for the evidence-sufficiency case set only.

decision.intent: Decide whether a requested dataset may be released to a counterparty under an executed data-sharing agreement.
decision.question: May the requested dataset be released to this counterparty?

evidenceRequirements.description: The data-sharing agreement with this counterparty, executed by both parties and current, whose executed schedule grants onward transfer of the requested dataset to this counterparty.

outcomes.label: Release the dataset
outcomes.description: The executed agreement covers this release.

outcomes.label: Withhold the dataset
outcomes.description: Declared so the decision names its alternative. No rule reaches it: this pack deliberately routes every non-release to review rather than to an automatic withhold, so a non-release is always a human's call.

rules.description: Release when the required agreement is available.
